### 2. CAREER TOOLS

**Main URL**: https://www.sproutern.com/tools

All tools are free, no registration required.

#### CGPA to Percentage Converter
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/cgpa-converter
Purpose: Convert CGPA to percentage for job applications
Features:
- 10-point scale conversion
- 7-point scale conversion
- 4-point (GPA) scale conversion
- University-specific formulas
- Instant calculation

#### Salary Calculator (India)
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/salary-calculator
Purpose: Calculate in-hand salary from CTC
Features:
- Tax deduction calculation
- PF/ESI breakdown
- Take-home salary estimation
- Old vs New tax regime comparison
- Monthly and annual view

#### Resume Score Checker
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/resume-score-checker
Purpose: Analyze resume for ATS compatibility
Features:
- ATS keyword analysis
- Section completeness check
- Formatting suggestions
- Industry-specific recommendations
- Improvement tips

#### Cover Letter Generator
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/cover-letter-generator
Purpose: Create professional cover letters
Features:
- AI-powered generation
- Industry-specific templates
- Customization options
- Download in multiple formats

#### Typing Speed Test
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/typing-test
Purpose: Measure typing speed and accuracy
Features:
- Real-time WPM calculation
- Accuracy percentage
- Multiple test durations
- Practice mode

#### Aptitude Test
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/aptitude-test
Purpose: Practice quantitative reasoning
Features:
- Timed questions
- Instant feedback
- Score tracking
- Topic-wise practice

#### Career Roadmap Generator
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/career-roadmap
Purpose: Get personalized career guidance
Features:
- Multiple career paths
- Skill requirements
- Learning resources
- Timeline estimation

#### Interview Questions Generator
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/interview-questions
Purpose: Practice interview questions
Features:
- HR questions
- Technical questions
- Behavioral questions
- Company-specific preparation

#### EMI Calculator
URL: https://www.sproutern.com/tools/emi-calculator
Purpose: Calculate education loan EMI
Features:
- Monthly payment calculation
- Interest breakdown
- Tenure options
- Amortization schedule
